title: HIV Self-Test Protocol
author: Serge Tonen-Wolyec
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k34cyqw

steps.title: Perform HIV Self-Test
steps.instruction: Conduct the HIV self-test using the Exacto ® Test HIV with a drop of whole-blood.

steps.title: Perform Initial Serological Screening
steps.instruction: Carry out serological HIV testing following the WHO II algorithm using two tests in series.

substeps.instruction: Perform Alere Determine™ HIV-1/2 (Alere Medical Co. Ltd., Matsudo-shi, Chiba-ken, Japan) as the first test.
Perform Uni-Gold TM HIV (Trinity Biotech Manufacturing Ltd., Bray, Co. Wicklow, Ireland) as the second confirmatory test.

steps.title: Collect and Process Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood via venipuncture and prepare plasma for reference laboratory use.

substeps.instruction: Draw blood into EDTA tubes on site.
Centrifuge samples at 1000 rpm for 15 min.
Aliquot the plasma and store frozen at -4° C.

steps.title: Re-test Positive or Indeterminate Samples
steps.instruction: Further test all positive and indeterminate samples from the initial WHO II screening on plasma according to the 2012-revised, 2015-consolidated 'WHO strategy for HIV testing'.

substeps.instruction: Perform Alere Determine™ HIV-1/2 (Alere Medical Co. Ltd.) as the first test.
Perform Uni-Gold TM HIV (Trinity Biotech Manufacturing Ltd.) as the second test.
Perform recomLine HIV-1 & HIV-2 ® IgG (Biosynex) as the third test.

steps.title: Assess HIV Viral Load
steps.instruction: Perform molecular biology assessment of HIV viral load on plasma samples.

substeps.instruction: Test all HIV-seropositive or indeterminate samples.
Test 1 out of 2 randomly selected HIV-seronegative plasmas.
